name: negative premium
sql: UPDATE quotes SET premium_cents=-1 WHERE id=1

name: orphan carrier
sql: UPDATE quotes SET carrier_id=999 WHERE id=1

name: invalid status
sql: UPDATE quotes SET status='Sold' WHERE id=1

name: invalid product
sql: UPDATE quotes SET quote_type='Boat' WHERE id=1

name: expiry before effective
sql: UPDATE quotes SET expiration_date='2020-01-01' WHERE id=1

name: duplicate coverage
sql: INSERT INTO quote_coverages SELECT * FROM quote_coverages WHERE quote_id=1 AND coverage_id=1

name: missing required name
sql: UPDATE prospects SET first_name=NULL WHERE id=1

name: invalid calendar date
sql: UPDATE quotes SET effective_date='2026-02-30' WHERE id=1

name: fractional cents
sql: UPDATE quotes SET premium_cents=100.5 WHERE id=1

name: future creation
sql: UPDATE quotes SET created_at='2027-01-01' WHERE id=1

name: quote before prospect
sql: UPDATE prospects SET created_at='2026-02-01' WHERE id=1
